listen_ip.description: The IP address the load balancer should listen on (e.g., 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, or a specific IP).

listen_port.description: The port number to listen on for incoming traffic.

servers.description: List of backend servers to balance traffic across.

host.description: Hostname or IP address of the backend server.

port.description: Port number of the backend service.

name.description: Optional human-readable name for this server (used for logging/documentation).

protocol.description: Protocol used by this backend (tcp or udp).

method.description: Algorithm used to distribute traffic across backends.

healthcheck_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between health checks. Set to 0 to disable health checks.

timeout.description: Connection timeout (in seconds) for backend connections.

max_connections.description: Maximum simultaneous connections allowed per backend. 0 = unlimited.

transparent.description: Enable transparent proxy mode to preserve client source IP (requires kernel support).

log_file.description: Path to log file. If empty, logging goes to syslog.

log_timestamps.description: Include timestamps in access log entries.

outbound_ip.description: Local IP address to use as source for connections to backends (for multi-homed systems).

sticky.description: Enable sticky sessions using client source IP for session persistence.
